Believing the idol was priced affordably around ₹1,900 within their budget, the other women leave to browse adjacent shops. When Madhavi stays behind to settle the bill, the store manager drops a bombshell—the idol actually costs ₹1,90,000, leaving her stunned and trapped in a huge financial predicament.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
